title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs (Part Two)

series.title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs (Part Two)

fullText.simplified:
第17章、国家的新样子

    关羽在华容道放走了曹操，诸葛亮没有生气，他说曹操现在还不能死。
    关羽不明白地问：“不能死？为什么？”
    诸葛亮看着南边的天，说：“因为如果曹操现在就死了，孙权和周瑜一定会马上拿下荆州，再打北方，他们会变成下一个曹操。当然，他们在做这些事情以前，会先打我们，先杀刘大人，所以现在我们还需要曹操。只要曹操没有死，孙权和周瑜就还不会杀刘大人。”
    关羽明白了，他点头说：“诸葛先生，你看得远，想得多，真是太聪明了！”
    诸葛亮笑了。他笑得很好看，眼睛很亮，就像天上的星星。
    刘备看着诸葛亮，突然想起第一次见到诸葛亮时，诸葛亮和他说过的那些话——“如果曹操败了，他也不会死，他会回到北方。等打完仗，您有了荆州，军队也多了，您就可以去西川。西川更大，您可以得到更多地方。那时候，您可以放心地做您想做的事，国家也会有新样子。”
    刘备吃惊得说不出话，虽然他没有听诸葛亮的话先拿下荆州，但后面的事情都和他说的一样。那个时候诸葛亮就已经知道现在的情况了吗？这真的太让人吃惊了。
    “诸葛先生，现在我们应该准备去西川了，对吗？”刘备问。
    诸葛亮说：“我们要去西川，但不是现在。江东的火虽然已经烧完了，但曹操在南方还有一些军队。这场仗还没有结束，我们还要再等一等。”
    刘备点头说：“好的，先生，我听你的。”
    门外有笑声，两个人高兴地走了进来，是张飞和赵云。张飞拿起桌上关羽的保证书，把它放进火里烧了。他大笑着说：“二哥不用死了，我太高兴了！”
    一直没有笑的关羽这时候终于笑了。大家都很高兴，笑得像孩子。
    刘备也在笑，但他一直看着诸葛亮，他的心里还有个声音在说：“右边是江东，是孙权的地方。左边是西川，会是您的地方。您得到西川后，可以找更多的军队，然后努力练习。等军队变多、变厉害了，再去北方打曹操，拿到北方的地方。”这也是第一次见到诸葛亮时，诸葛亮对刘备说过的话。
    刘备的眼睛红了，他好像看到了一张地图，地图上只有三个地方和三个名字：江东、西川和北方，孙权、刘备和曹操，这就是国家的新样子吗？
    刘备激动极了，他突然很想快点儿见到这个样子的国家。
fullText.traditional:
第17章、國家的新樣子

    關羽在華容道放走了曹操，諸葛亮沒有生氣，他說曹操現在還不能死。
    關羽不明白地問：“不能死？為什麼？”
    諸葛亮看著南邊的天，說：“因為如果曹操現在就死了，孫權和周瑜一定會馬上拿下荊州，再打北方，他們會變成下一個曹操。當然，他們在做這些事情以前，會先打我們，先殺劉大人，所以現在我們還需要曹操。只要曹操沒有死，孫權和周瑜就還不會殺劉大人。”
    關羽明白了，他點頭說：“諸葛先生，你看得遠，想得多，真是太聰明了！”
    諸葛亮笑了。他笑得很好看，眼睛很亮，就像天上的星星。
    劉備看著諸葛亮，突然想起第一次見到諸葛亮時，諸葛亮和他說過的那些話——“如果曹操敗了，他也不會死，他會回到北方。等打完仗，您有了荊州，軍隊也多了，您就可以去西川。西川更大，您可以得到更多地方。那時候，您可以放心地做您想做的事，國家也會有新樣子。”
    劉備吃驚得說不出話，雖然他沒有聽諸葛亮的話先拿下荊州，但後面的事情都和他說的一樣。那個時候諸葛亮就已經知道現在的情況了嗎？這真的太讓人吃驚了。
    “諸葛先生，現在我們應該準備去西川了，對嗎？”劉備問。
    諸葛亮說：“我們要去西川，但不是現在。江東的火雖然已經燒完了，但曹操在南方還有一些軍隊。這場仗還沒有結束，我們還要再等一等。”
    劉備點頭說：“好的，先生，我聽你的。”
    門外有笑聲，兩個人高興地走了進來，是張飛和趙雲。張飛拿起桌上關羽的保證書，把它放進火裡燒了。他大笑著說：“二哥不用死了，我太高興了！”
    一直沒有笑的關羽這時候終於笑了。大家都很高興，笑得像孩子。
    劉備也在笑，但他一直看著諸葛亮，他的心裡還有個聲音在說：“右邊是江東，是孫權的地方。左邊是西川，會是您的地方。您得到西川後，可以找更多的軍隊，然後努力練習。等軍隊變多、變厲害了，再去北方打曹操，拿到北方的地方。”這也是第一次見到諸葛亮時，諸葛亮對劉備說過的話。
    劉備的眼睛紅了，他好像看到了一張地圖，地圖上只有三個地方和三個名字：江東、西川和北方，孫權、劉備和曹操，這就是國家的新樣子嗎？
    劉備激動極了，他突然很想快點兒見到這個樣子的國家。

sentences.pinyin: liú bèi de yǎn jing hóng le tā hǎo xiàng kàn dào le yì zhāng dì tú dì tú shang zhǐ yǒu sān ge dì fang hé sān ge míng zi
sentences.english: Liu Bei’s eyes reddened, as if he saw a map in his mind, with only three places and three names on it:

sentences.simplified: 江东、西川和北方，孙权、刘备和曹操，这就是国家的新样子吗？
sentences.traditional: 江東、西川和北方，孫權、劉備和曹操，這就是國家的新樣子嗎？
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng xī chuān hé běi fāng sūn quán liú bèi hé cáo cāo zhè jiù shì guó jiā de xīn yàng zi ma
sentences.english: Jiangdong, Xichuan, and the north. Sun Quan, Liu Bei, and Cao Cao. Was this the new look of the country?

sentences.simplified: 刘备激动极了，他突然很想快点儿见到这个样子的国家。
sentences.traditional: 劉備激動極了，他突然很想快點兒見到這個樣子的國家。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi jī dòng jí le tā tū rán hěn xiǎng kuài diǎn'r jiàn dào zhè ge yàng zi de guó jiā
sentences.english: Liu Bei was very excited. He suddenly wanted to see this kind of country as soon as possible.

sentence_translations: Chapter 17: The Country’s New Look
Guan Yu ket Cao Cao go at the Huarong Trail. Zhuge Liang was not angry. He said that Cao Cao must not die yet.
Guan Yu did not understand and asked, “Must not die? Why?”
Zhuge Liang looked at the southern sky and said, ..
.. “Because if Cao Cao dies now, Sun Quan and Zhou Yu will definitely take Jingzhou immediately and then fight the north.
They will become the next Cao Cao.
Of course, before they do these things, they will attack us and kill Lord Liu first. So, we still need Cao Cao now.
As long as Cao Cao is not dead, Sun Quan and Zhou Yu will not kill Lord Liu.”
Guan Yu understood and nodded, saying, “Mr. Zhuge, you see far and think deeply. You are truly very wise!”
Zhuge Liang smiled. He had an attractivce smile, and his eyes shone brightly, just like the stars in the sky.
Liu Bei looked at Zhuge Liang and suddenly remembered the words Zhuge Liang had said to him during their first meeting:
“If Cao Cao is defeated, he won’t die. He will return to the north.
After the battle is over, you will have Jingzhou. You will also have more troops, and you can go to Xichuan.
Xichuan is even bigger, and you can obtain even more territory.
Then, you can feel free to do the things you want, and the country will also have a new look.”
Liu Bei was so taken aback that he was unable to speak.
Although he did not follow Zhuge Liang’s advice to first take Jingzhou, everything else was just as Zhuge Liang had said.
Did Zhuge Liang already know about the current situation back then? This was truly astonishing.
“Mr. Zhuge, should we now prepare to go to Xichuan?” Liu Bei asked.
Zhuge Liang said, “We will go to Xichuan, but not right now.
Although the fire in Jiangdong has been extinguished, Cao Cao still has some troops in the south.
This battle is not over yet. We still need to wait a bit longer.”
Liu Bei nodded and said, “Alright, Sir. I will listen to you.”
There was laughter coming from outside the door. Two people walked in happily. They were Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun.
Zhang Fei picked up Guan Yu’s pledge from the table and burned it in the fire.
He laughed heartily and said, “Second Brother doesn’t have to die, I’m so happy!”
Guan Yu, who had not laughed until then, finally laughed. Everyone was very happy, and they laughed like children.
Liu Bei was also laughing, but he kept looking at Zhuge Liang. There was a voice in his mind that was saying:
“On the right is Jiangdong, which is Sun Quan’s territory. On the left is Xichuan, which will be your territory.
After you take Xichuan, you can find more troops and then train hard.
After your army becomes bigger and stronger, then you can fight Cao Cao in the north and get territory in the north.
This is also what Zhuge Liang said to Liu Bei the first time they met.
Liu Bei’s eyes reddened, as if he saw a map in his mind, with only three places and three names on it:
Jiangdong, Xichuan, and the north. Sun Quan, Liu Bei, and Cao Cao. Was this the new look of the country?
Liu Bei was very excited. He suddenly wanted to see this kind of country as soon as possible.
